conviction_note: The findings sum to -1.0: a probable H1 operating-margin shortfall at the group's highest-margin division (-2.0), partly offset by what looks like an overdone sell-off on the ASCA fire (+1.0). Both run against the +0.6 lean and against a stock already down 12.3% over 20 sessions, and the H1 bar is unsourced, so I emit -0.5 rather than -1.0. The name moves a lot on results (last six moves +1.8/+7.8/+6.4/-9.6/-8.5/+13.9), so the sign here is a weak lean and the size is small on purpose.

findings.finding: E-CONNECT is the group's highest-margin division (ROC 36.0% of revenue in H1 2025, EUR2.7m of the group's EUR21.1m). Its H1 2026 revenue fell 17.4% to EUR6.2m, and Q2 fell 29.3%. The company itself warned of component-cost pressure (the 2026 RAM supply crisis) and said R&D costs keep rising. So H1 group ROC margin is more likely flat-to-down against 18.2% than up, while ODDO's FY26 model assumes margins recover to 21%. That is the same setup as H1 2025, when margin fell 110bp and the stock lost 8.8%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: H1 2025 results (26/09/2025, after the close): revenue +7.4% but ROC margin 18.2% vs 19.3%; the stock fell 8.76% to EUR40.60, last on the SRD, with the press headlining 'la rentabilité pose question' (https://www.boursorama.com/bourse/actualites/la-valeur-du-jour-a-paris-equasens-ameliore-ses-resultats-semestriels-mais-la-rentabilite-pose-question-882e85e0491844602329125dadd53f48). FY2025 results were in line on margin and the stock rose 11.84% (https://www.marketscreener.com/news/equasens-surges-following-2025-results-analysts-approve-ce7e51d9db89f224). So this name trades on the margin line.
findings.original_quote: « Contrairement au T1, l'activité du T2 est en retrait marqué à 2,8 M€ (-29,3% par rapport au T2 2025) [...] Le marché reste sensible au contexte économique, tandis que les tensions actuelles sur les chaînes d'approvisionnement devraient peser sur les coûts de production. » -- translation: 'Unlike Q1, Q2 activity fell sharply to EUR2.8m (-29.3% vs Q2 2025) [...] The market remains sensitive to the economic context, while current supply-chain tensions should weigh on production costs.' Base from the H1 2025 release: « DivisionE-CONNECT : un résultat opérationnel courant en croissance (2,7 M€) et un ratio de rentabilité en retrait (ROC/CA : 36,0% au titre du S1 2025 contre 45,9% au titre du S1 2024) ». Bar: ODDO « confirmons notre scénario de rebond des marges à travers une Moc de 21%e (vs 20.8%e) ».
findings.why_not_priced: The revenue miss is priced: the stock fell from 34.10 to 29.30 (-14%) after 30/07. The margin is not: both notes on the company's own site raised or held their margin view after the revenue print. ODDO's headline was 'signaux positifs quant à l'amélioration de la profitabilité' and it lifted its FY Moc to 21%. The E-CONNECT margin base (36%) and the component-cost warning sit in French segment tables, not in the English headline. If the market had priced a second year of H1 margin compression, the sell-side margin estimates would have been cut in July and the stock would not be sitting on a 50% upside target at ODDO. What cuts against this finding: maintenance and subscriptions grew +8.4% (high margin), EREVO is accretive at 'un niveau de rentabilité en ligne avec les performances du Groupe', and the -14% drawdown may already hold a lower bar than ODDO's. Net of those, I estimate group ROC at roughly EUR21.5-22.5m (17.3-18.1%) against a bar I cannot source for H1.
findings.independence: There is no independent source of the margin read. The H1 2025 segment table (https://fr.ftp.opendatasoft.com/datadila/INFOFI/MKW/2025/09/FCMKW130108_20250926.pdf) and the FY2025 release (https://fr.ftp.opendatasoft.com/datadila/INFOFI/MKW/2026/03/FCMKW132910_20260330.pdf, which already flagged 'le marché mondial de la RAM [...] traverse en 2026 une crise d'approvisionnement') are the same issuer's own documents. GreenSome independently flagged E-CONNECT's Q2 as 'bien inférieur à nos attentes'.

findings.finding: The subsidiary whose Chessy site burned on 21/09 is material, and its bounded disruption looks small against the price reaction. ASCA INFORMATIQUE filed 2025 revenue of EUR28.4m and an operating result of EUR9.67m (about 12% of group revenue and about 20% of group ROC). The company capped the total interruption of installations at four weeks and has declared the loss to insurers. Four weeks of ASCA is at most about EUR0.75m of operating profit before insurance and before deferred (not lost) installations, about 1.5% of group FY ROC, yet the stock fell 6.5% (30.90 to 28.90) on 22-24/09. Monday's H1 release (post-closing events) and the SFAF meeting are the first chance to quantify it.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: No prior operational-incident disclosure found for this issuer. On this event the stock fell 2.6% on 22/09 (24k shares) and 3.3% on 23/09 (52.7k, about 3x normal), then rose 1.4% on 25/09 intraday (Yahoo tape).
findings.original_quote: « Le bâtiment ainsi que les stocks qui y étaient entreposés ont été détruits. [...] compte-tenu des livraisons à venir, la période d'interruption totale des installations devrait se limiter à quatre semaines. [...] Le sinistre a été déclaré aux assureurs et les experts ont été sollicités afin d'en évaluer les conséquences. » -- translation: 'The building and the stock stored there were destroyed. [...] given upcoming deliveries, the period of total interruption of installations should be limited to four weeks. [...] The loss has been declared to insurers and experts engaged to assess its consequences.' ASCA's size is from the registry (pappers, fiscal year 2025-12-31): chiffre_affaires 28,395,008; resultat_exploitation 9,666,000; resultat 7,206,988.
findings.why_not_priced: The release described ASCA only by '4 200 clients' and '25 collaborateurs', with no revenue, profit or insurance figure, so the market priced a fire with no size. The size (EUR28m revenue, 34% operating margin) is only in the French registry filings, and no wire or analyst piece I found carried it (the BFM/tradingsat and Boursorama pieces restate the release). If the market had sized a four-week, insured interruption against EUR9.7m a year of operating profit, the loss would have been about 1-2% of group value, not the 6.5% seen over 22-24/09. The caveat, and why this is only +1.0: the same size fact tells the market that ESL is a large profit pool, so any SFAF hint of a longer outage or lost clients would cut the other way. The company has put its own four-week bound in writing, which limits that risk.
findings.independence: The fire and its scale are confirmed by the local authority (https://www.chessy77.fr/nos-actualites/retour-sur-lincendie-rue-des-quilles-a-chessy, snippet_only) and local radio (https://sevenradio.fr/2026/09/23/gros-incendie-industriel-a-chessy-les-pompiers-ont-lutte-toute-la-nuit/, snippet_only). The ASCA financials come from a different source (https://www.pappers.fr/entreprise/asca-informatique-434023867). Nothing independent confirms the insurance outcome.

baseline_tension: Net negative findings cut against the +0.61 lean and against a -12.3% 20-day and -16.3% 60-day run-up, whose free control (-run_up) points up. The emitted number (-0.5) is therefore half the findings sum (-1.0).
language_note: The E-CONNECT division's H1 2025 ROC margin (36.0%) and FY2025 margin (33.4%) are in the French segment tables of the AMF-filed releases. They are the base the margin finding rests on; the English wire copy carries only group totals.

The company's own warning on component costs ('les tensions actuelles sur les chaînes d'approvisionnement devraient peser sur les coûts de production') and on the RAM supply crisis sits in the French division commentary, not in any English headline.

Both July 2026 broker notes (ODDO BHF 'First Take', GreenSome) are French-language PDFs hosted on equasens.com. They carry the only sourceable bar (ODDO's FY Moc raised to 21%) and GreenSome's flag on E-CONNECT's Q2.

ASCA INFORMATIQUE's 2025 accounts (EUR28.4m revenue, EUR9.67m operating result) come from the French company registry via pappers. No English source and no French press item carried the subsidiary's size.
The issuer's French agenda page ('Résultats 1er semestre 2026 (avant bourse)') settled the session; English sources gave only the date.
lessons_applied: 'Positioning / truncated zero': I rewrote positioning_check to say that 0.0 is the 0.5% floor with anchor_covered false, not evidence of no shorts, so the lean is effectively the run-up.

'The hunter's own caveat has to reach the number' and 'macro-to-company is a hypothesis': the margin finding is my own model of segment data against an unsourced H1 bar, so I cut it from -2.5 to -2.0.

'If baseline_tension says the evidence cuts against the lean, expected_move must be visibly smaller than the sum': the emitted move went from -1.0 (with a -1.5 sum) to -0.5 (with a -1.0 sum), half the findings.
'A one_off is sized at a fraction': I kept the ASCA finding at +1.0 (not raised) and wrote out its path to the H2 guide and the offsetting risk that the size fact cuts both ways.
